meta.name: ebay-item-detail
meta.description: Extracts full item detail from any open eBay item URL, returning JSON with url, itemNumber, title, subTitle, categories, price, priceWithCurrency, currency, wasPrice, available, availableText, sold, image, images, seller, sellerUrl, sellerFeedbackCount, sellerPositiveRating, itemLocation, brand, type, mpn, upc, ean, condition, shippingCost, shipping, whyToBuy, and itemSpecifics (full label/value map). Works across all eBay regional TLDs. Use when user mentions eBay item page, eBay listing detail, eBay product page, eBay itm, ebay.com/itm, eBay item scraper, extract eBay item details, eBay item specifics, scrape eBay item, eBay sold count, eBay availability, eBay brand MPN UPC EAN, eBay item location, eBay seller feedback, eBay wasPrice, eBay hi-res images, eBay itemNumber, eBay per-item enrichment. Also applies to enriching item URLs from a listing, monitoring price and stock, competitive product research, brand catalog audits, and pulling full field set from an individual eBay listing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取任意eBay商品页面的完整详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从eBay商品页获取结构化数据
copy.tagline_en: Extract full item details from any eBay listing page
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured data from eBay item pages

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能提取当前打开的 eBay 商品页面的完整信息，包括标题、价格、库存、卖家、图片、商品规格等，并以 JSON 格式返回。
howto.when: 当用户提到 eBay 商品页面、商品详情、商品链接（如 ebay.com/itm/...），或要求提取 eBay 商品信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个 eBay 商品页面的详细信息。
say.note: Claude 会读取当前页面并返回 JSON 数据。

say.text: 这个 eBay 商品还有货吗？价格是多少？
say.note: Claude 会提取库存和价格信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can extract full item details from an open eBay item page, including title, price, stock, seller, images, and item specifics, returning a JSON object.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions an eBay item page, listing detail, item URL (e.g., ebay.com/itm/...), or asks to extract eBay item information.

say_en.text: Extract the full details of this eBay item page.
say_en.note: Claude will read the current page and return JSON data.

say_en.text: Is this eBay item still available? What's the price?
say_en.note: Claude will extract stock and price info.
